name: Daishin Securities Co.,Ltd
summary: Daishin Securities Co.,Ltd operates as a financial investment company in Korea and internationally. It engages in dealing, brokerage, underwriting, investment trust, and other services. The company also provides retirement pension products, real estate trust, urban redevelopment projects, collateralized bond trusts, agency services, real estate consulting, and asset management for Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs).
